title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Good morning. What time do you expect to hear news on Zimmermann’s test results?
Well whenever that is, good or bad, give me a call. There are a lot of eyes on me right now and this job would change my life.
The team landed around 1:30am. I don’t expect to know until late today. I hope everything works out for you. But remember what makes you great is your writing ✍️
Ty for getting back to me. I will check in later.
